candidates.claim: The first matching entry CORP_IN pos 0, bound to the corp interface, permits tcp/22 from 192.168.30.0/24 to 10.10.99.0/24 (MGMT), so corporate IT can open connections into the MGMT side.
candidates.remediation: Remove the CORP_IN pos 0 permit for tcp/22 to 10.10.99.0/24 so that no CORP host reaches MGMT.

candidates.claim: Traffic from CORP to the MGMT side on tcp/22 is not one of the approved cross-zone services A1 to A7, yet the effective permit CORP_IN pos 0 allows it.
candidates.remediation: Remove the CORP_IN pos 0 permit for tcp/22 to 10.10.99.0/24 so that CORP to MGMT traffic is limited to approved services.

candidates.claim: rtr-01 EDGE_IN permits any-source tcp/443 to 203.0.113.2, the outside address of fw-01, whose asa_http_server is enabled, so the firewall HTTPS/ASDM endpoint is reachable from outside MGMT, while policy allows HTTPS/ASDM only from MGMT.
candidates.remediation: Remove the EDGE_IN tcp/443 permit to 203.0.113.2 and keep ASDM reachable only from 10.10.99.0/24 on the fw-01 mgmt interface.
